Centenary 14-18: official ceremony at the Arc de Triomphe
To commemorate the Centenary of the Armistice of WWI, over 60 heads of state and 120 foreign dignitaries will
gather at the Arc de Triomphe this Sunday November 11, 2018 at 10 a.m. "In the name of remembrance and
peace creation", they will listen to a name of soldiers who died during their mission these past 12 months.
